Doublet of cipher and chiffre. Cognate with Spanish cero and French zéro.

senses.definition: the symbol or digit 0 representing the number zero

examples.en: A million is written with a one and six zeroes.
examples.vi: Một triệu được viết bằng một số một và sáu chữ số không.

senses.definition: the point marked 0 on a scale, especially for measuring temperature

examples.en: The temperature fell to ten degrees below zero overnight.
examples.vi: Nhiệt độ đã giảm xuống mười độ dưới không qua đêm.

senses.definition: no amount, value, or quantity at all; complete absence of something

examples.en: Our chances of winning the final match are close to zero.
examples.vi: Cơ hội chiến thắng trận chung kết của chúng tôi gần như bằng không.

senses.vi: con số không; trạng thái không

senses.definition: a person who is considered to have no importance or success

examples.en: He treats his employees as if they are total zeroes.
examples.vi: Ông ta đối xử với nhân viên như thể họ là những kẻ hoàn toàn bất tài.

senses.vi: kẻ bất tài; người vô giá trị

examples: One million has six zeroes.
wiktionary.gloss: The digit 0 in the decimal, binary, and all other base numbering systems.

wiktionary.gloss: Nothing, or none.

examples: The electromagnetic field does not drop all of the way to zero before a reversal.
wiktionary.gloss: The value of a magnitude corresponding to the cardinal number zero.

examples: The temperature outside is ten degrees below zero.
wiktionary.gloss: The point on a scale at which numbering or measurement originates.

examples: The zeroes of a polynomial are its roots by the fundamental theorem of algebra.
The derivative of a continuous, differentiable function that twice crosses the axis must have a zero.
wiktionary.gloss: A value of the independent variables of a function, for which the function is equal to zero.

examples: Since a commutative zero is the inverse of any additive identity, it must be unique when it exists.
The zero (of a ring or field) has the property that the product of the zero with any element yields the zero.
wiktionary.gloss: The additive identity element of a monoid or greater algebraic structure, particularly a group or ring.

examples: They rudely treated him like a zero.
wiktionary.gloss: A person dismissed as unimportant.

examples: Sometimes a difference in intended meaning has only a zero to mark it, in which case the utterance may be ambiguous when context alone does not fully clarify it.

examples: The takeovers were financed by issuing zeroes.
